title: The Best Habit Tracker
body: I must have tried almost all the habit trackers on the App Store, but this is my favourite, and replaced Streaks. I love the clean interface and ability to have tasks that can be completed a few times a week rather than everyday. Thank you so much for this wonderful app and your hard work in creating it, I appreciate it!!
author: G1g1g1g1g1

title: Very good product
body: Does all the basic things and is the best without any unwanted perks and is way better than those paid apps
